[[Guardsman Pei]] serves two purposes.  He guards the gate to [[Vizunah Square (Local Quarter)]] and can provide information on what to do to gain entrance.  Inside, he provides information helpful to the upcoming mission.

== Locations ==
* [[Kaineng City]]
** {{NPC location|Vizunah Square (Local Quarter)}}
** {{NPC location|The Undercity}}

== Quests ==
'''Quests involved in:'''
* [[Kaineng City]]
** [[Mayhem in the Market]]

== Dialogue ==
=== Vizunah Square (Local Quarter) ===
: ''"[[Master Togo]] has sent word to [[Mhenlo]] of [[Tyria]].  He is Togo's prize student from years ago.  In fact, Togo has not held another student in such high regard until you came along.  Hopefully, he can help us in our time of need."''

: ''"What would you like to know?"''

: '''⇒ Remind me again, what happened in Cantha?'''
:: ''"You, along with Togo and [[Headmaster Vhang]], tracked down and eliminated the source of the plague.  You took it upon yourself to inform [[Jia|Yijo's mother]] of the plague that consumed her [[Yijo Tahn|son]], but it seemed as though she already knew.  Togo sent you the city to investigate the sickness, as he is not convinced that your victory at [[Zen Daijun]] purged the land of its ill effects.  In the meantime, Togo is visiting [[Raisu Palace]] to consult with the [[Emperor Kisu|emperor]]."''

:: '''⇒ Let's talk about something else.'''

: '''⇒ What is going on in Vizunah Square?'''
:: ''"You are here to join up with Mhenlo, one of Togo's former students. With any luck, Mhenlo has made haste in his travels and brought company; the plague is causing more damage than anyone expected."''

:: '''⇒ Let's talk about something else.'''

: '''⇒ Do you have any information you can share about the task at hand?'''
:: ''"1. [[Afflicted|Plague creatures]] [[Afflicted Soul Explosion|explode]] upon death. Anyone nearby will suffer damage."''

:: ''"2. Protection and self-healing skills are crucial tools in the battle against the Afflicted."''

:: ''"3. Keep Master Togo and Mhenlo alive; without them, all is lost."''

:: ''"4. Be prepared to suffer numerous [[Conditions]]."''

:: '''⇒ Let's talk about something else.'''

: '''⇒ Replay the mission cinematic.'''

: {{no}} '''I'll be on my way.'''

=== The Undercity ===
Before [[A Master's Burden]] for Canthan [[character]]s. After [[Zen Daijun]] for non-Canthan characters.
:''"[[Master Togo]] left specific instructions that I am to admit only a {{sic}} certain students once he has finished speaking with the emperor.  <Character name> does not have permission. I suggest heading to [[Kaineng Docks]] and speaking with [[Headmaster Greico]] about getting permission.  He usually waits near the docks whenever Master Togo is visiting the city.  What else did you need?"''

During A Master's Burden
:''"I think Master Togo is in the [[Wajjun Bazaar]].  I heard someone say that he was visiting the mother of one of his best students....  <Character name> should be able to find him there.  I'd watch out for the [[Jade Brotherhood]] and the [[Am Fah]], though.  How else may I assist you?"''

Before Mayhem in the Market
:''"<Character name> should talk to Headmaster Greico.  He would have more information.  Master Togo said simply to wait until he had spoken with the emperor.  Until then, this gate is sealed.  What else did you need?"''

Early parts of Mayhem in the Market
:''"A group of students was just here.  They headed into Wajjun Bazaar.  After you go there, you would do well to check the Undercity.  <Character name> should be able to find them there.  I'd watch out for the Jade Brotherhood and the Am Fah, though.  What else did you need?"''

End of Mayhem in the Market
:''"By order of the emperor, none shall pass!"''

Default
:''"You enter this quarter at your own risk. Was there something else you wanted to discuss?"''

For non-Canthan characters before Zen Daijun
:''"Master Togo left specific instructions that I am to admit only certain students once he is finished speaking with the emperor.  You do not have permission.  I suggest you head over to Kaineng Docks and speak with Master Togo.  Last I heard, he was traveling with Headmaster Greico."''

== Notes ==
{{bug|Non-Canthans will be permanently stuck on the first response, even if they have access to the local quarters.  The Headmaster will have no information for them.}}
